# AI readiness of the federal statistical system: host-level findings

> Host-level AI-readiness findings for the sixteen recognized agencies and units of the US federal statistical system, plus three federal reference hosts shown separately. Five host-level checks over one measurement cycle with one declared client identity, every verdict traceable to the Finding, the rule version and the retained response body that produced it. The matrices, the per-check source appendix and every registered Result the report quotes are published as data beside it; the PDF is a view of them.

Snapshot cycle `scan_2026-09-10_rj2`, version `2026-09-10_rj2`. The data below is the publication; the markdown and the PDF are views of it.

## Data

- [Matrix, tierA, JSON. The 16 Tier A bodies × the six host-level checks.](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/reports/scan_matrix_tierA_2026-09-10_rj2.json)
- [Matrix, tierA, CSV. The 16 Tier A bodies × the six host-level checks.](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/reports/scan_matrix_tierA_2026-09-10_rj2.csv)
- [Matrix, tierC, JSON. The three federal reference hosts, in no Tier A denominator (DD-059).](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/reports/scan_matrix_tierC_2026-09-10_rj2.json)
- [Matrix, tierC, CSV. The three federal reference hosts, in no Tier A denominator (DD-059).](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/reports/scan_matrix_tierC_2026-09-10_rj2.csv)
- [Matrix, product, JSON. PARTIAL: product-level checks over declared flagship surfaces only.](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/reports/scan_matrix_product_2026-09-10_rj2.json)
- [Matrix, product, CSV. PARTIAL: product-level checks over declared flagship surfaces only.](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/reports/scan_matrix_product_2026-09-10_rj2.csv)
- [The per-check source appendix: every check, every admitted source, its doc_id, its URL and its locator.](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/data/sources_per_check.json)
- [Every registered Result the report quotes: name, value, state, provenance.](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/data/results_tagged.json)
- [The framework record: indicators, constructs, measurement specs and the evidence cells the source appendix reads its locators from.](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/data/ai_readiness_framework.json)
- [The corpus manifest: every admitted document with its identity, its source URL and its content hash. Every doc_id in the source appendix is a key in this file.](https://brockwebb.github.io/ai-readiness-kg/data/corpus_manifest.json)
